canvas_scrubber_blueprint.architecture: Pinned HTML5 Canvas with RequestAnimationFrame (rAF) and LERP Interpolation
canvas_scrubber_blueprint.format: WebP (80-85% quality, lossy with transparent alpha or obsidian backdrop)
canvas_scrubber_blueprint.frame_count_recommendation: 60 to 180 frames for full 360-degree rotation or exploded view
canvas_scrubber_blueprint.preloading_strategy: Sequential asynchronous preloading with loaded count progress indicator
canvas_scrubber_blueprint.scroll_binding: GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub: 1 or Lenis smooth-scroll delta mapping
canvas_scrubber_blueprint.resizing_strategy: Canvas dynamic DPR (window.devicePixelRatio capped at 2.0) with cover-fit math
